description: Implement game-specific scoring engines in packages/game-rules and the DB-aware standings computer in packages/scoring. All functions in game-rules are pure (no Prisma). packages/scoring owns computeTournamentStandings which calls Prisma, converts Decimal to Number, then calls game-rules. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-001 and can be worked in parallel in principle, but is executed sequentially after FEAT-001.
steps: Create packages/game-rules/src/types.ts with these interfaces: PlacementRow { teamId: string; placement: number; kills: number; penalties?: number }; TieBreaker { field: 'kills' | 'placement' | 'points' | 'custom'; order: 'asc' | 'desc' }; MatchScoreParams { config: ScoringConfig; placements: PlacementRow[]; matchId: string }; TeamStanding { teamId: string; totalPoints: number; totalKills: number; matchesPlayed: number; bestPlacement: number | null; rank: number }; SeriesResult { teamId: string; wins: number; losses: number; roundsWon: number; roundsLost: number }; ApprovedMatchScore { matchId: string; teamId: string; points: number; kills: number; placement: number | null }. Import ScoringConfig from @esports/shared-types.

Create packages/game-rules/src/bgmi.ts. Export BGMI_DEFAULT_CONFIG: ScoringConfig = { game: 'BGMI', killPoints: 1, placementPoints: [15,12,10,8,6,5,4,3,2,1,0,0,0,0,0,0], maxKillPoints: undefined }. Export calculateMatchScore(params: MatchScoreParams): ApprovedMatchScore[] — for each PlacementRow: pointsFromPlacement = config.placementPoints[placement-1] ?? 0; pointsFromKills = row.kills * config.killPoints; if config.maxKillPoints exists clamp kills points; total = pointsFromPlacement + pointsFromKills - (row.penalties ?? 0); return ApprovedMatchScore. Export calculateStandings(scores: ApprovedMatchScore[]): TeamStanding[] — group by teamId summing points, kills, counting matches played, tracking best placement, then sort by totalPoints desc then totalKills desc, assign rank. Export applyTiebreakers(standings: TeamStanding[], tiebreakers: TieBreaker[]): TeamStanding[] — re-sort by tiebreaker fields in order, reassign rank.

Create packages/game-rules/src/free-fire.ts. Export FREE_FIRE_DEFAULT_CONFIG: ScoringConfig = { game: 'FREE_FIRE', killPoints: 1, placementPoints: [12,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0,0], booyahBonus: 2 }. Export calculateMatchScore (same logic as bgmi, apply booyahBonus to placement=1 team). Export calculateStandings (same as bgmi). Export calculateClashSquadSeries(results: { teamId: string; win: boolean }[]): SeriesResult[] — count wins and losses per teamId, return array sorted by wins desc.

Create packages/game-rules/src/codm.ts. Export CODM_BR_DEFAULT_CONFIG: ScoringConfig = { game: 'COD_MOBILE', mode: 'BATTLE_ROYALE', killPoints: 1, placementPoints: [15,12,10,8,6,5,4,3,2,1,0,0], winBonus: 0 }. Export calculateMatchScore and calculateStandings (same pattern as bgmi). Export calculateMultiplayerSeries(results: { teamId: string; roundsWon: number; roundsLost: number }[]): SeriesResult[] — aggregate rounds per teamId; a 'win' is when roundsWon > roundsLost in the aggregated total; sort by wins desc then roundsWon desc.

Create packages/game-rules/src/defaults.ts. Export getDefaultConfig(game: 'BGMI' | 'FREE_FIRE' | 'COD_MOBILE', mode: 'BATTLE_ROYALE' | 'CLASH_SQUAD' | 'MULTIPLAYER'): ScoringConfig. Switch on game: BGMI → always return BGMI_DEFAULT_CONFIG; FREE_FIRE → always return FREE_FIRE_DEFAULT_CONFIG; COD_MOBILE → return CODM_BR_DEFAULT_CONFIG (BATTLE_ROYALE or CLASH_SQUAD uses BR config; MULTIPLAYER also uses CODM_BR_DEFAULT_CONFIG with mode overridden). Throw Error('Unknown game/mode combination') for any unrecognised input.

Replace stub in packages/game-rules/src/index.ts: export * from './types'; export * from './bgmi'; export * from './free-fire'; export * from './codm'; export * from './defaults'. Run 'pnpm --filter @esports/game-rules build'.

Create packages/scoring/src/standings.ts. Import PrismaClient type from @esports/database. Import ApprovedMatchScore, TeamStanding, calculateStandings from @esports/game-rules. Export async computeTournamentStandings(prisma: PrismaClient, tournamentId: string, guildId: string): Promise<TeamStanding[]>. Query: prisma.scoreEvent.findMany({ where: { match: { stage: { tournamentId, tournament: { guildId } } }, status: 'active' }, select: { matchId: true, teamId: true, points: true, kills: true, placement: true } }). Map each row to ApprovedMatchScore: { matchId: row.matchId, teamId: row.teamId, points: Number(row.points), kills: row.kills, placement: row.placement }. Call calculateStandings(scores) and return the result.
Replace stub in packages/scoring/src/index.ts: export { computeTournamentStandings } from './standings'. Run 'pnpm --filter @esports/scoring build'.
acceptance_criteria: getDefaultConfig('BGMI', 'BATTLE_ROYALE') returns an object with game: 'BGMI'
No Prisma import exists in any file under packages/game-rules/src/
findings: calculateMatchScore and calculateStandings are exported per-game with aliases (calculateBgmiMatchScore, calculateFreeFireMatchScore, calculateCodmMatchScore, calculateBgmiStandings, calculateFreeFireStandings, calculateCodmStandings) to avoid ambiguous re-export conflicts. A generic calculateStandings (from bgmi) is also re-exported for use by @esports/scoring. CODM_BR_DEFAULT_CONFIG is typed as CodmScoringConfig (not the union ScoringConfig) so property access is safe in defaults.ts. computeTournamentStandings in @esports/scoring calls prisma.scoreEvent.findMany with guildId scope through match→stage→tournament relation, converts Decimal points via Number(), and delegates to calculateStandings. Both packages pass tsc build (exit 0). Commit: 349263e.
